A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same multimodal textbook study and contain readable main text and complete supplementary material. Comparison of extracted text and rendered pages supports reliable judgments across all dimensions.

before.justification: v1 reports original VLM pretraining evaluations, context-awareness tests, ablations, dataset statistics, and manual quality evaluation in Sections 4–5 and 7.2.

after.justification: v4 retains these original experimental and data-analysis results, including Tables 1–7 and the manual evaluation in Section 7.2.

M1.justification: The taxonomy-based collection, ASR refinement, multilevel filtering, SSIM keyframe extraction, OCR processing, and chronological interleaving remain unchanged. Algorithm 1 and the appendix sample-construction procedures also match.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same six-subject instructional corpus and evaluate ScienceQA-IMG, OKVQA, TextVQA with its OCR variant, MathVista, MathVision, and MathVerse. Newly cited MMMU and Video-MMMU are not added evaluations.

E2.justification: Corresponding comparisons retain the same MMC4 variants and OBELICS baselines, dataset-statistics comparators, and alternative keyframe extractors. The newly cited Phi models are not experimentally evaluated.

E3.justification: Both versions retain matched 610K pretraining samples, the same LLaVA and Idefics2 configurations, few-shot settings, and instruction-tuning evaluation. Appendix Section 8.1 preserves the retrieval procedure, cross-dataset mathematics examples, and evaluation prompt.

E4.justification: The one- and two-shot Cheat Tests, image-order shuffling analysis, ASR/OCR ablations, keyframe-extractor comparisons, manual inspection, and illustrated appendix examples are unchanged.

E5.justification: Both versions use the same point-estimate reporting without repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests. No uncertainty-reporting procedure is added or removed.

E6.justification: Tables 1–7, Figure 3, and the appendix findings retain the same results. For example, Table 2 reports the same one-shot averages of 31.1 for Textbook-6.5M and 22.8 for OBELICS in both versions.

T1.justification: Section 7.5 retains the identical InSI-SIM definition and Equation 1 combining pairwise CLIP and SSIM similarities. No formal assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same corpus contribution and claims about knowledge-rich, coherent interleaving, reasoning-task performance, and in-context learning. The added background references do not change these claims.

C2.justification: The explanations of context awareness, image coherence, ASR refinement, OCR, and keyframe selection remain unchanged. Section 9 retains the same limitations concerning residual data noise and the focus on understanding and text generation.

D1.justification: v4 changes the project-site address and removes the anonymous code/partial-dataset access link from Section 7.1, while retaining the public GitHub link. Implementation details, licensing, and the stated Hugging Face hosting plan are unchanged; actual resource availability cannot be established from the PDFs.

R1.justification: v4 adds eight references: five Phi/textbook works, Video-MMMU, MMMU, and Embodied-Reasoner. A new introductory sentence explicitly connects textbook-quality training data to the Phi series, modestly expanding the scholarly context without substantially changing the contribution's positioning.

P1.justification: Changes include the short Phi-background sentence, an author contact email, removal of the anonymous-access sentence, and deletion of the redundant 'website-crawled' descriptor. Section order and nearly all explanatory prose remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Front-matter additions, the expanded bibliography, and local text reflow alter spacing and page composition. All seven tables and ten figures retain their content and designs; appendix PDF pages 14–20 render identically.

improvement.justification: v4 modestly improves scholarly grounding by explicitly acknowledging the Phi/Textbooks Are All You Need lineage in the introduction and adding relevant references. The methods, empirical evidence, interpretations, and limitations remain unchanged, so the gain is limited. Revised access pointers do not establish improved resource availability.
